message: 左を狙え
Mmm, what a refreshing morning!

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mornin'!」

name: Synn
message: 「Morning.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I made soba!」
Nanaka's smile was beaming. It was dazzling.

name: Sally
message: 「Ooh, soba! I'm eating!」

name: Paqy
message: 「The great me is picky about daikon radish.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then none for P.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Who cares about daikon radish anyway.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mmm. What a nice morning!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hope the weather's like this tomorrow too.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Agreed!」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't look sleepy today.」
Does this mean things turned out just like Melilot said they would?
I hope that's the case, though.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, yeah. Bubuzuke's house really was the problem! The direction, the luck, everything was the worst. It is Bubuzuke's place, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's terri--」

name: Synn
message: 「Bylous?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh, Bylous...? Synn, huh, ah, hey!」
I instinctively ran over.

name: Bylous
message: 「...Are you there.」

name: Synn
message: 「...What happened?」

name: Bylous
message: 「Had a little... run-in... with an angel... I can't let you... be killed... right now, after all...」
Bylous looked like he was about to vanish at any moment.

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-Hey, what is this? A ghost?!」

name: Bylous
message: 「I somehow... managed to drive it off... though...」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel, all by yourself!?」

name: Bylous
message: 「Aim for... her left... Nive and I... wounded the same spot... three... times... There has to be an opening...」

name: Synn
message: 「G-Got it. Her left. So, you really shouldn't talk anymore--」
Bylous smiled.

name: Bylous
message: 「...Watch out... for Soltia...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Synn! This ghost just looked right at me!?」
The right half of Bylous's flickering body wavered violently, and vanished.

name: Bylous
message: 「Is this... as far as I go...」
His left half shimmered and vanished.
Only his head and right arm remained, swaying like a picture painted on a sail blown by the wind.

name: Synn
message: 「Bylous!」

name: Bylous
message: 「If... the world... doesn't end... someday... with you...!」
No sooner had the right hand reaching out to me crumbled away from the fingertips than his face vanished like smoke.

name: Synn
message: 「...Why did you protect me?」
There was no answer.

name: Paqy
message: 「Looks like he couldn't hold his existence together in this world anymore.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Still, though. A demon of his caliber? Give him a few years and he'll revive in the Demon World.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Was that guy... someone you knew, Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... yeah... Though I only ever met him once.」
He and I fought together just once. That's all. That's all it was.
To me, he wasn't an enemy. And yet. He wasn't an ally either.
Even so, it made me sad.
